sub_indicators.label: Use of open data
sub_indicators.subject: data.open
sub_indicators.text: Use of open data: use of open data
sub_indicators.norm_short: The African Union's Data Policy Framework (2022) and the Africa Data Consensus (2015) ask governments to open the data they hold for anyone to use, and to see it used.
criteria: A source from the past three years says no public body publishes data for anyone to download.
A public body publishes data online for anyone to download, on a portal or its own site, in the past three years. A dashboard with nothing to download, or a portal only planned, does not count.
That data is published under an open licence or terms that let anyone reuse it, such as Creative Commons or the Licence Ouverte.
Two or more public bodies publish data that way, named or counted by a source from the past three years.
Four or more public bodies publish data that way, named or counted by a source from the past two years.

aspects.name: Data published for download, and under an open licence
